summary: Iteration 8 verifies Phases B/C/D/E for PHI Console. Ran unit tests for the 4 new phases (test_publish_guard.py, test_ocr_pdf.py, test_actual_knowledge_attestation.py, test_preview.py) — all 36 tests PASSED. Live-tested regression endpoints (/api/health, /api/coverage-matrix, /api/classification-accuracy, /api/sessions/{sid}/bundle, /api/sessions/{sid}/preview). Live-tested Phase E /human-review 400 gating (no ack, ack=false, no reviewer) and 404 on fake sid — all pass. Structurally verified SessionDetail.jsx contains all required data-testids and regulatory copy for Phase D & Phase E UI. No awaiting_human_review session existed live (server actually uses status 'awaiting_review' not 'awaiting_human_review'), so full end-to-end UI submit could not be exercised, but structural verification against source is complete.

minor.issue: Response uses category_accuracy=1.0 & action_accuracy=1.0 keys instead of overall_f1 / macro_f1 / method_appropriateness mentioned in review request. Functionally equivalent (100%>=0.95), but field-name spec drift vs review request.

server.py sets status='awaiting_review' (lines 474, 524) while review request and doc references consistently use 'awaiting_human_review'. Frontend guards behavior on `session.status === 'awaiting_review'` — consistent internally, but naming diverges from spec doc.

Existing legacy tests in tests/test_agent_pipeline.py::test_human_review_and_export and tests/backend_test.py::test_narrative_flow still POST without actual_knowledge_ack=true so they now return 400. These integration tests were not updated for Phase E. Also test_agent_pipeline.py::test_llm_settings_default / test_results_decisions / test_results_audit_ledger_herald_populated fail due to cascade from that (audit missing verdict because session never advanced). 5 test failures out of 137 (132 passed). Not a code bug — these are outdated test fixtures.

action_items: Update tests/test_agent_pipeline.py test_human_review_and_export to POST actual_knowledge_ack=true (mirroring test_human_review_invariant.py fix). Same for tests/backend_test.py test_narrative_flow. Currently 5 legacy pipeline tests fail because they no longer satisfy the Phase E HHS attestation gate.

Consider aligning session status vocabulary: server.py uses 'awaiting_review' whereas review request and SessionDetail.jsx conditional check 'awaiting_review' — the string 'awaiting_human_review' in the spec should either be adopted server-side or the spec doc updated. Currently frontend & backend are consistent (both use 'awaiting_review'), only doc drift.

Optional: expose overall_f1 / macro_f1 / method_appropriateness on /api/classification-accuracy to match review-request wording (existing category_accuracy/action_accuracy already communicate 100% accuracy).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend Phase E endpoint gating is correctly ordered (400 for missing reviewer + 400 for missing actual_knowledge_ack BEFORE db lookup) — good defensive design.
phi_core/preview.py partial-mask enforcement is verifiable via test_preview_original_never_returned_raw — no raw cell leakage in preview payloads.

SessionDetail.jsx correctly gates BOTH Submit and Accept-globally buttons on !actualKnowledgeAck && !spotCheckSatisfied && !reviewer.trim(). Both testids actual-knowledge-ack (per-column) and actual-knowledge-ack-global (no-rows) exist as spec requires.

Bundle attestation.json for legacy session d36e4593 shows actual_knowledge_ack:false — expected since session was completed before Phase E landed. New sessions going through the endpoint will get true; verified via test_bundle_zip_contains_actual_knowledge_ack_field_in_json_and_text (PASSED).
server.py is 938 lines — approaching the 700-line refactor threshold. Consider extracting the /human-review and /preview handlers into a router module.

success_rate.backend: 96% (132/137 tests; 5 outdated legacy tests fail Phase E gate)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (structural verification of all Phase D/E testids and regulatory copy)

seed_data_creation: None; used existing complete session d36e4593276a41e799be6738e496c1e3 for preview + bundle assertions. Fake sid 'notarealsid' used to confirm 404.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B/C/D/E all landed cleanly. Only outstanding items are (a) update 2 legacy integration test files (test_agent_pipeline.py, backend_test.py) to send actual_knowledge_ack=true in the /human-review payload, and (b) optional: alias 'awaiting_review' <-> 'awaiting_human_review'. No live awaiting_review session existed at the time of testing so end-to-end UI submit was verified structurally against SessionDetail.jsx source; create a session that flows into awaiting_review to exercise the browser UI ack + submit path if needed.
rca of the issue: Legacy pipeline test failures RCA: Phase E introduced a mandatory actual_knowledge_ack=true field in HumanReviewSubmit at server.py:761 with early 400 rejection at server.py:781-787. The updated invariant test (test_human_review_invariant.py) was properly modified, but two legacy integration tests (test_agent_pipeline.py line 203, tests/backend_test.py test_narrative_flow) still send the old payload shape without the attestation flag, so they now receive HTTP 400 and cannot advance the session — leading to cascade assertion failures in the same file about audit verdict being empty. Mitigation: add `"actual_knowledge_ack": true` (and reviewer field) to those two POST payloads. This is a test-fixture update only, not a code bug.
